# SYNTHETIC study-interface generator

`generate.py` creates deterministic invented outcome/energy data, raw placeholders,
normalized source-shaped JSON and explicitly synthetic permits in a NEW directory.
It is not an ingestion/weekly-price reconstruction fixture and claims no official
observations, legal clearance or empirical recovery. Actual source adapters already
have their own separate tests. The known 13 missing calendar slots are retained.
No real private source is read by this generator or the CI study smoke.
